candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /rendezvenyek/osszes, harvest event IDs, then fetch {event}/{id}/program, /eloadok, /tamogatok per event and per year; parse speaker name+title+company and sponsor tier blocks into an actor table.

candidates.source_name: Portfolio Banking Technology 2025 – sponsors page (támogatók)

Observed tiers include Platinum: Visa; Super Gold: OTP Bank; Gold: Gránit Bank, K&H Bank; plus a Silver tier of technology/financial vendors, and 60+ confirmed participating companies. Sponsor tier is a direct proxy for who is willing to spend to reach Hungarian banking buyers.

brief: Hungary's conference-and-awards layer is unusually legible: two commercial organisers dominate and both publish structured sponsor tiers — Portfolio.hu (Banking Technology, Financial IT, Future of Finance) with a stable /program, /eloadok, /tamogatok URL pattern going back to 2017, and FinTechZone's *TechShow family (FinTechShow, BankTechShow, PayTechShow, TechShow X in Oct 2026) which additionally publishes a separate kiállítók/exhibitor tier where smaller payments and POS vendors appear. Payment-specific coverage comes from IIR Hungary's Kártyapiac series and businessevents.hu's AFR 2.0 Digital Payment conference, while merchant-side POS and cash-register vendors surface instead in HUNGEXPO trade-fair exhibitor directories such as Sirha Budapest. The awards layer is anchored by Mastercard's Év Bankja (segment winners 2025: OTP overall, Gránit in Innovation, K&H in Beyond Banking), IVSZ's Gyurós Tibor-díj (which explicitly awards 'digitalisation project of the year', naming supplier and client), the Magyar Innovációs Nagydíj, and Az Év Honlapja, with MNB's Lámfalussy Lectures and Budapest Eurasia Forum supplying the regulator-adjacent network. Sponsor-page structure is confirmed but company-level rosters are largely uncollected — these URLs are targets, and none should be treated as verified-live until the deterministic pass runs.
